title: Chicken karahi
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer it in plenty of salted water until tender, then drain.
Heat the oil in a wok-style pan and sear the chicken pieces until coloured on all sides.
Add the garlic, ginger and chopped tomatoes and cook on high heat, stirring, until the tomatoes break down into a thick sauce.
Stir in the spices, yogurt and slit green chillies and cook for 10 minutes until the oil separates and the chicken is cooked through.
Finish with fresh coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken tikka rice bowl
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, grated garlic and ginger, spices and salt, then coat the chicken pieces and leave for at least 15 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted water until fluffy.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Dice the cucumber and onion and toss with chopped mint.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the cucumber salad on the side.

title: Daal chawal
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer them with turmeric in 700 ml water for about 25 minutes until soft.
Cook the rice separately until tender.
Warm the ghee, fry the sliced onion until golden, then add garlic, ginger, cumin and chilli for one minute.
Add the chopped tomato, cook until soft, then stir this tarka into the lentils with the salt.
Top with coriander and serve over the rice.

title: Aloo gobi with roti
steps: Knead the flour with a pinch of salt and enough water to make a soft dough, then rest it.
Fry the onion in the oil until soft, add garlic, ginger and spices, then the chopped tomato.
Add the potato cubes and cauliflower florets with a splash of water, cover and cook on low until tender.
Roll the dough into thin rounds and cook each on a hot dry pan until puffed and spotted.
Scatter coriander over the curry and serve with the warm roti.

title: Chana masala with rice
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Soften the chopped onion in the oil, then add garlic, ginger and the ground spices for one minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook down for five minutes.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes, crushing a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Keema matar
steps: Make a soft dough from the flour, water and a pinch of salt and let it rest.
Brown the onion in the oil, add garlic, ginger and chilli, then add the mince and cook until it loses its pink colour.
Stir in the spices and chopped tomato and cook until the mixture looks dry and glossy.
Add the peas with a splash of water and cook for 8 minutes.
Roll and dry-cook thin roti and serve with the keema.

title: Chicken pulao
steps: Soak the rice in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Fry the sliced onion in the oil until deep golden, then add whole spices, garlic and ginger.
Add the chicken and brown it, then stir in the yogurt and cook for five minutes.
Add the rice and hot stock, bring to the boil, then cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes.
Rest covered for five minutes and fluff with a fork before serving.

title: Seekh kebab plate
steps: Grate the onion and squeeze out the liquid, then mix it into the lamb with garlic, ginger, chilli, coriander, spices and salt.
Shape the mixture into long kebabs around skewers and chill for 10 minutes.
Grill under high heat for 10–12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Stir chopped mint into the yogurt and slice the cucumber and tomato.
Serve the kebabs with warm naan, the salad and the mint raita.

title: Palak paneer with roti
steps: Wilt the spinach in a covered pan with a splash of water, then blend it roughly.
Fry the onion in the ghee until soft, then add garlic, ginger, chilli and spices.
Add the chopped tomato and cook down, then stir in the spinach and simmer for five minutes.
Add cubes of paneer and warm through gently.
Serve with freshly cooked roti.

title: Slow-cooked beef nihari
steps: Fry half the sliced onion in ghee until golden, then add the beef, garlic, ginger and spices and brown well.
Cover with 1 litre of water and simmer gently for about two hours until the beef is very tender.
Whisk the flour with a little water and stir it in to thicken the gravy, cooking for 10 more minutes.
Crisp the remaining onion in a dry pan.
Serve topped with the crispy onion, coriander and lemon, with warm naan.

title: Masala omelette with wholewheat paratha
steps: Make a soft dough from the flour and water, roll it out, brush with half the ghee, fold and roll again.
Cook the paratha on a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Beat the eggs with finely chopped onion, tomato, chilli, coriander and salt.
Cook the egg mixture in the rest of the ghee until just set and fold it over.
Serve the omelette with the paratha.

title: Lahori-style roast chicken with salad
steps: Slash the drumsticks and coat with yogurt, lemon, garlic, ginger, spices and salt; leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with the oil and a little salt.
Roast the chicken and potatoes at 220°C for 30–35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and charred at the edges.
Chop the cucumber, tomato and onion into a quick salad.
Serve together with an extra squeeze of lemon.

title: Bhindi masala with daal
steps: Simmer the lentils in 500 ml water with turmeric until soft, then season.
Dry the okra well and slice it; fry it in half the oil until no longer sticky, then set aside.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil, add garlic and spices, then the tomato and cook until soft.
Return the okra to the pan and cook for 5 minutes more.
Serve with the daal and freshly cooked roti.

title: Chicken haleem
steps: Soak the chickpeas overnight, then simmer them with the lentils, barley and oats in plenty of water for about an hour until very soft.
Simmer the chicken separately with garlic, ginger and spices until cooked, then shred it.
Combine everything and stir vigorously or blend briefly until thick and stringy.
Fry the sliced onion in ghee until crisp.
Serve topped with crispy onion, coriander and lemon.

title: Aloo anday (egg and potato curry)
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then add garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the tomato and cook to a thick paste, then add potato cubes and 300 ml water.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender, then add the halved eggs for 5 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

title: Chapli kebab in a bun
steps: Mix the mince with finely chopped onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, spices, egg, cornflour and salt.
Shape into two large flat patties.
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes each side until cooked through.
Toast the muffins and layer with lettuce, the kebab and a spoon of yogurt.
Serve straight away.

title: Vegetable pulao with raita
steps: Soak the rice for 20 minutes and drain.
Fry the sliced onion in the oil with the whole spices until golden.
Add the diced vegetables and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then add the rice and 350 ml hot water with the salt.
Cover and cook on very low heat for 15 minutes, then rest for 5.
Grate the cucumber into the yogurt for raita and serve on the side.

title: Chicken jalfrezi
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Stir-fry the chicken strips in the oil until sealed.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices, then the chopped tomato and cook for 5 minutes.
Add thick slices of pepper and onion and stir-fry on high heat so they stay crunchy.
Serve with the rice.

title: Fish tikka with lemon rice
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon, garlic, ginger, spices and salt and coat the fish chunks.
Cook the rice with the peas and a pinch of turmeric.
Thread the fish onto skewers and grill for 8–10 minutes until just flaking.
Drizzle the rice with a little lemon and the oil.
Serve the fish on the lemon rice.

title: Mango lassi overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, yogurt, milk and cardamom together in a jar.
Chop the mango and fold half of it in.
Cover and chill overnight.
Top with the rest of the mango and chopped pistachios before eating.

title: Chana chaat
steps: Boil the potato until tender, cool and dice.
Combine with the drained chickpeas and finely chopped onion, tomato and cucumber.
Loosen the tamarind with a little water and mix with lemon juice, cumin, chilli and salt.
Toss everything together and top with coriander.

title: Yogurt chickpea bowl (dahi chana)
steps: Whisk the yogurt with a pinch of salt until smooth.
Spoon the drained chickpeas into a bowl and pour over the yogurt.
Drizzle with loosened tamarind and dust with roasted cumin and chilli.
Finish with coriander.

title: Lighter butter chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, half the garlic and ginger, half the spices and salt.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until coloured, then set aside.
Melt the butter, fry the remaining garlic and ginger, add the remaining spices and passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the chicken, stir in the cream and crushed fenugreek and simmer until cooked through.
Serve with the rice.

title: Palak tofu
steps: Cook the brown rice until tender.
Wilt and blend the spinach.
Fry the onion in the oil, add garlic, ginger and spices, then tomato and cook down.
Add the spinach and cubes of tofu and simmer gently for 8 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

title: Rajma chawal
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then add garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the tomatoes and cook to a thick sauce.
Stir in the drained beans with 150 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few to thicken.
Serve over rice with coriander.

title: Spiced potato wrap (dosa-style)
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and crush them roughly.
Fry the mustard seeds in the oil until they pop, then add the onion, chilli and turmeric.
Fold in the potatoes and peas with salt and a splash of water.
Warm the wraps in a dry pan, fill with the potato mix and roll.
Serve with yogurt and coriander.

title: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, half the garlic, ginger and spices.
Grill the chicken until charred.
Fry the onion in the oil, add the rest of the garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomatoes; simmer for 10 minutes and blend.
Add the chicken and cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with rice and coriander.

title: Egg bhurji on toast
steps: Fry the onion and chilli in the oil until soft.
Add the tomato and turmeric and cook for a minute.
Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble gently until just set.
Toast the bread and pile the eggs on top with coriander.

title: Moong dal chilla with yogurt
steps: Soak the mung beans for at least four hours, then blend with a little water into a pourable batter.
Stir in finely chopped onion, ginger, chilli, cumin and salt.
Spread ladlefuls thinly on a lightly oiled hot pan and cook until golden on both sides.
Serve with yogurt and coriander.

title: Kerala-style prawn curry
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Pop the mustard seeds in the coconut oil, then fry the onion until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, spices and tomato and cook down.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a simmer and add the prawns for 3–4 minutes until pink.
Serve with the rice.

title: Lighter dal makhani
steps: Simmer the lentils in 800 ml water for 40 minutes until creamy.
Fry the onion in the butter, add garlic, ginger, cumin and chilli, then the tomato paste.
Add this to the lentils with the kidney beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and season.
Serve with the rice.

title: Tandoori salmon with kachumber
steps: Cook the brown rice until tender.
Coat the salmon with yogurt, lemon, garlic, ginger, spices and salt.
Roast at 220°C for 12–14 minutes.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and onion and toss with coriander and a little lemon.
Serve the salmon with the rice and kachumber.

title: Chana dal tadka with roti
steps: Soak the split chickpeas for an hour, then simmer with turmeric until soft, about 40 minutes.
Fry the onion in ghee, add cumin, garlic, ginger and chilli, then the tomato.
Pour the tadka into the dal and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook thin roti on a hot dry pan.
Serve together.

title: Vegetable biryani
steps: Par-boil the rice for 5 minutes and drain.
Fry half the onion until crisp in the ghee and set aside; fry the rest with garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the vegetables and yogurt and cook for 8 minutes.
Layer the rice over the vegetables, drizzle with saffron water, cover tightly and steam on low heat for 20 minutes.
Top with crispy onion, toasted cashews and mint.

title: Paneer tikka wrap
steps: Coat cubes of paneer, pepper and onion with yogurt, lemon, curry powder and salt.
Grill or pan-roast until charred at the edges.
Warm the wraps.
Fill with lettuce, the paneer mixture and torn mint and roll tightly.

title: Chicken saag
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in the oil.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger and spices and cook until soft.
Add the chopped tomato, then the spinach in handfuls until wilted.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Serve with warm naan.

title: Vegetable upma
steps: Dry-roast the semolina until fragrant and set aside.
Pop the mustard seeds in the oil, then add cashews, onion, chilli, ginger and diced vegetables.
Pour in 400 ml hot water with salt and bring to the boil.
Stir in the semolina slowly and cook, stirring, until thick.
Finish with lemon and coriander.

title: Aloo matar with tofu
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Fry the onion in the oil, then add garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the tomatoes, diced potato and 200 ml water and simmer until the potato is nearly soft.
Add the peas and tofu cubes and cook for 8 more minutes.
Serve with the rice.

title: Masala chai porridge
steps: Warm the milk with the spices.
Stir in the oats and cook for 4–5 minutes until creamy.
Sweeten with honey.
Top with sliced almonds.

title: Sprouted moong salad
steps: Boil the diced potato until tender and cool it; rinse the sprouts and drain well.
Toss the sprouts and potato with diced paneer and finely chopped tomato and onion.
Dress with lemon, cumin, chilli and salt.
Top with crushed peanuts and coriander.

title: Goan fish curry
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the onion in the oil, add garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomato.
Add the coconut milk and tamarind and simmer for 5 minutes.
Slide in the fish chunks and simmer gently for 6–8 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

title: Lighter chicken korma
steps: Blend the almonds with a little water into a paste.
Fry the onion in the oil until soft, then add garlic, ginger and whole spices.
Add the chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in the yogurt and almond paste and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

title: Spiced roasted chickpeas and nuts
steps: Dry the drained chickpeas thoroughly.
Toss with the oil, spices and salt.
Roast at 200°C for 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway, adding the peanuts for the last 8 minutes.
Cool completely to crisp up before storing.

title: Chicken shawarma plate
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon, garlic, spices, oil and salt and coat the chicken; leave for 20 minutes.
Roast at 220°C or grill for 18–20 minutes until charred and cooked through, then slice.
Loosen the tahini with lemon and water to make a pourable sauce.
Chop the tomato, cucumber and parsley into a salad.
Serve the chicken with warm pita, salad and tahini sauce.

title: Baked falafel bowl
steps: Soak the dry chickpeas overnight, drain, then blitz with onion, garlic, herbs, spices and salt to a coarse paste.
Shape into small patties, brush with oil and bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, turning once.
Cover the bulgur with boiling water, leave for 10 minutes and fluff.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and water.
Serve the falafel on bulgur with chopped salad and tahini sauce.

title: Hummus chicken bowl
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes, then fluff.
Season the chicken with paprika and salt and grill or pan-fry until cooked through, then slice.
Chop the cucumber, tomato, onion and parsley and dress with lemon and oil.
Spread hummus in each bowl and top with quinoa, salad and chicken.

title: Shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, then add garlic and spices.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make small wells and crack in the eggs, then cover and cook until the whites set.
Crumble feta over and scatter parsley.
Serve with toasted sourdough.

title: Lamb kofta with tabbouleh
steps: Mix the lamb with grated onion, a little parsley, the spices and salt, then shape into small koftas.
Grill or pan-fry for 8–10 minutes until cooked through.
Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 10 minutes, then toss with lots of chopped parsley and mint, tomato, cucumber, lemon and oil.
Serve the koftas on the tabbouleh with yogurt.

title: Mujaddara (lentils and rice with crispy onions)
steps: Simmer the lentils for 15 minutes until half cooked.
Add the rice, cumin, salt and enough water to cover by 2 cm, then cover and cook gently for 18 minutes.
Meanwhile fry the thinly sliced onion in the oil slowly until deep brown and crisp.
Stir half the onions through the lentils and rice and pile the rest on top.
Serve with yogurt and cucumber.

title: Fattoush with grilled chicken
steps: Grill the chicken until cooked through and slice.
Toast the pita until crisp and break it into pieces.
Chop the lettuce, tomato, cucumber, radish, spring onion and herbs.
Whisk the lemon, oil and salt and toss everything together just before serving.

title: Ful medames
steps: Warm the fava beans with a splash of water, then mash them roughly.
Stir in crushed garlic, cumin, lemon juice and salt.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes and halve them.
Drizzle the beans with oil, top with chopped tomato and parsley and serve with the eggs and pita.

title: Chicken and bulgur pilaf
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, add spices and bulgur and stir for a minute.
Add the stock and chicken, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, then fluff and top with toasted almonds and parsley.
Serve with yogurt.

title: Baba ganoush with crudités
steps: Roast the whole aubergine at 220°C for 30 minutes until collapsed.
Scoop out the flesh and mash with tahini, garlic, lemon, salt and most of the oil.
Drizzle with the remaining oil.
Serve with carrot and cucumber sticks and toasted pita.

title: Red lentil soup (shorbat adas)
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil.
Add the spices, lentils and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season with salt and lemon.
Serve with toasted pita.

title: Strained yogurt breakfast plate
steps: Spread the yogurt on a plate and drizzle with oil.
Sprinkle with thyme, sesame and a pinch of salt.
Slice the cucumber and tomato and add the olives.
Serve with warm pita.

title: Sumac-style chicken and onion wrap
steps: Cook the sliced onion slowly in the oil until soft and sweet.
Season the chicken with paprika, lemon and salt and cook until done, then shred.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan.
Fill the wraps with onions, chicken, pine nuts and yogurt, roll, then toast in a dry pan until crisp.

title: Grilled vegetable and chickpea skewers
steps: Toss chunks of courgette, pepper, onion and mushroom with half the oil, spices and salt and thread onto skewers.
Grill for 12–15 minutes, turning.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Warm the chickpeas, then dress with lemon, the rest of the oil and parsley.
Serve the skewers on couscous with the chickpeas.

title: Baked beef and bulgur kibbeh
steps: Soak the bulgur for 15 minutes, squeeze dry and knead with half the mince, half the onion, spices and salt.
Fry the remaining onion and mince with the pine nuts as a filling.
Press half the bulgur mix into an oiled dish, add the filling, then cover with the rest.
Score the top, brush with oil and bake at 190°C for 35 minutes.
Serve with yogurt and cucumber.

title: Tuna tabbouleh bowl
steps: Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 10 minutes and drain well.
Chop the herbs, tomato and cucumber finely.
Toss everything with lemon, oil and salt.
Flake the tuna over the top.

title: Red pepper and walnut dip
steps: Drain the roasted peppers.
Blend with walnuts, breadcrumbs, garlic, cumin, lemon, oil and salt to a coarse paste.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Serve with carrot sticks.

title: Shish tawook with garlic yogurt
steps: Marinate the chicken cubes in half the yogurt with lemon, half the garlic, tomato paste, paprika, oil and salt.
Thread onto skewers with pepper and onion and grill for 12–15 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender.
Mix the remaining yogurt with the remaining garlic.
Serve the skewers on rice with the garlic yogurt.

title: Spinach and feta flatbread
steps: Wilt the spinach with the onion in the oil, then squeeze out the liquid.
Season with lemon and a little salt.
Spread over the pita and crumble the feta on top.
Bake at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until crisp.

title: Herby scrambled eggs with za'atar-style seasoning
steps: Scramble the eggs gently in the oil.
Mix the thyme and sesame with a pinch of salt and sprinkle over.
Slice the tomato and cucumber.
Serve with warm pita.

title: Red lentil kofte with lettuce cups
steps: Simmer the lentils in 400 ml water until soft and most water is absorbed, then stir in the bulgur, cover and rest for 15 minutes.
Fry the onion in the oil with tomato paste and spices, then mix into the lentils with parsley and salt.
Knead and shape into small oval kofte.
Serve wrapped in lettuce leaves with lemon.

title: Chicken kabsa
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, then remove.
Fry the onion, garlic and whole spices, then add the tomato, tomato paste and grated carrot.
Return the chicken with 700 ml water and simmer for 25 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, add the rinsed rice to the broth, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes.
Serve the rice topped with the chicken, raisins and toasted almonds.

title: Lamb machboos
steps: Brown the lamb in the ghee with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, chopped tomato and 1 litre of water and simmer for about an hour until tender.
Remove the lamb and measure 450 ml of broth back into the pan.
Add the rice, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes.
Serve the rice with the lamb and coriander.

title: Harees (wheat and chicken porridge)
steps: Soak the bulgur for an hour.
Simmer the chicken with the spices in 1.2 litres of water until very tender, then shred it.
Add the bulgur to the broth and cook slowly for about an hour, stirring often.
Return the chicken and beat with a wooden spoon until smooth and thick.
Serve with a drizzle of melted ghee.

title: Grilled spiced fish with rice
steps: Rub the fish with lemon, garlic, spices, oil and salt.
Grill for 6–8 minutes each side until it flakes easily.
Cook the rice.
Serve with sliced tomato and cucumber.

title: Spiced lentil and vegetable stew
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the spices.
Add the lentils, diced potato, carrot, tomato and 800 ml water.
Simmer for 30 minutes until thick and tender.
Season and serve with pita.

title: Sweet vermicelli with omelette
steps: Boil the pasta (broken vermicelli or thin spaghetti) until just tender and drain.
Toss with butter, sugar, cardamom and saffron soaked in a spoon of hot water.
Make a thin omelette with the eggs and salt.
Serve the omelette on top of the sweet noodles.

title: Chicken mandi
steps: Rub the chicken with the ground spices and salt.
Fry the onion in ghee, add the rice and 550 ml water, and bring to the boil.
Place the chicken on a rack or directly on top of the rice, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 45 minutes.
Toast the almonds and raisins.
Serve the rice topped with chicken, almonds and raisins.

title: Dates and nut yogurt bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Chop the dates and scatter them over.
Add the walnuts and a pinch of cardamom.

title: Prawn machboos
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the spices and tomato.
Add the rice and 380 ml water, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Sear the prawns quickly in a hot pan.
Fold the prawns into the rice and rest for 5 minutes.
Finish with coriander and lemon.

title: Saloona vegetable stew with chickpeas
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil with the spices.
Add the diced vegetables and tomatoes with 300 ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then add the chickpeas for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Serve the stew over the rice.

title: Grilled white fish with fattoush salad
steps: Season the fish with salt and half the lemon and grill for 4–5 minutes each side.
Toast and break the pita.
Chop the vegetables and mint.
Toss with oil and remaining lemon and serve with the fish.

title: Chicken tagine with apricots
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, then soften the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, stock, apricots and chickpeas and return the chicken.
Cover and simmer gently for 40 minutes.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Serve the tagine over the couscous with coriander.

title: Harira soup
steps: Soften the onion, celery and garlic in the oil.
Add the spices, lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and herbs for the last 10 minutes.
Season with lemon and serve with pita.

title: Spiced lamb and egg skillet
steps: Brown the lamb with the onion and pepper.
Add garlic and spices, then the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.
Serve with toasted sourdough.

title: Seven-vegetable couscous
steps: Soften the onion in the oil with the spices.
Add the stock, tomatoes, carrot and turnip and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the butternut, courgette, chickpeas and raisins and simmer for 15 minutes more.
Steam or soak the couscous until fluffy.
Ladle the vegetables and broth over the couscous.

title: Chermoula baked fish
steps: Blend the herbs, garlic, spices, lemon, oil and salt into a chermoula paste.
Slice the potatoes thinly and par-boil for 5 minutes.
Layer potatoes and tomato in a dish, place the fish on top and spread with chermoula.
Scatter olives and bake at 200°C for 18–20 minutes.

title: Koshari
steps: Cook the lentils for 15 minutes, add the rice and cook together until both are tender.
Boil the pasta separately.
Fry the sliced onion in the oil until crisp.
Simmer the passata with garlic, cumin, chilli, vinegar and salt for 10 minutes.
Layer rice and lentils, pasta and chickpeas, then top with the sauce and crispy onions.

title: Moroccan carrot and chickpea salad
steps: Slice the carrots and simmer for 6–8 minutes until just tender.
Drain and toss while warm with spices, lemon, oil and salt.
Add the chickpeas, raisins and parsley.
Serve warm or cold.

title: Flatbread with eggs and tomato
steps: Fry the eggs in the oil.
Warm the flatbread in a dry pan.
Grate the tomato and season it with cumin and salt.
Serve the eggs on the flatbread with the tomato.

title: Beef kefta tagine
steps: Mix the beef with grated onion, parsley, half the spices and salt, and roll into small balls.
Simmer the tomatoes with garlic, the rest of the spices and oil for 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs and cook covered for 12 minutes.
Crack in the eggs and cook until set.
Serve with bread.

title: Zaalouk aubergine and tomato bowl
steps: Cook the diced aubergine in the oil until soft and golden.
Add garlic, spices and tomatoes and simmer, mashing, for 15 minutes.
Stir in the beans and warm through.
Soak the couscous in boiling water.
Serve the zaalouk over couscous with parsley.

title: Date, oat and almond butter bites
steps: Stone the dates and blitz them with the oats, almond butter and cinnamon until the mixture sticks together.
Roll into six small balls.
Chill for 20 minutes to firm up.

title: Protein pancakes with berries
steps: Blend the oats, eggs, banana, whey and milk into a smooth batter.
Lightly oil a non-stick pan and cook small pancakes for about 2 minutes each side.
Stack them up and top with blueberries.
Drizzle with maple syrup.

title: Turkey and bean chili
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil, breaking it up.
Add the onion, pepper and garlic and soften for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices, tomatoes and beans and simmer for 30 minutes.
Cook the brown rice meanwhile.
Serve the chili over the rice.

title: Cheeseburger bowl
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil and salt and roast at 220°C for 25 minutes.
Brown the mince in a hot pan until crisp and season.
Shred the lettuce and chop the tomato, cucumber and onion.
Pile the salad and mince into bowls, scatter with cheddar and drizzle with mustard and ketchup.
Serve with the potato wedges.

title: Chicken Caesar salad (light dressing)
steps: Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through and slice.
Cube the bread, toss with the oil and toast until golden.
Whisk the yogurt, lemon, garlic, mustard, Worcestershire, half the parmesan and salt into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, then top with chicken, croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

title: Sirloin steak with sweet potato and greens
steps: Roast the sweet potatoes whole at 200°C for 30 minutes, or until soft.
Season the steak with salt and pepper and sear in the oil for 3–4 minutes each side, then rest.
Steam the green beans and toss with butter and garlic.
Slice the steak and serve with the split sweet potatoes and beans.

title: Spinach and feta egg-white omelette
steps: Sauté the mushrooms and spinach in the oil until soft.
Whisk the egg whites with the whole egg and salt and pour over.
Cook gently until set, sprinkle with feta and fold.
Serve with a slice of wholemeal toast.

title: BBQ chicken with corn and slaw
steps: Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, paprika and garlic powder into a quick BBQ sauce.
Brush the chicken with the sauce and bake at 210°C for 25 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and sweetcorn until tender.
Shred the cabbage and carrot and mix with yogurt and salt for slaw.
Serve everything together.

title: Turkey club wrap
steps: Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it.
Lay the wrap flat and add lettuce, turkey, tomato and sliced avocado.
Add the bacon and mustard.
Roll tightly and cut in half.

title: Peanut butter overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and chia together in a jar.
Swirl in the peanut butter.
Chill overnight.
Top with sliced banana in the morning.

title: Salmon quinoa power bowl
steps: Simmer the quinoa for 15 minutes and fluff.
Roast the salmon at 200°C for 12–14 minutes.
Massage the kale with lemon and oil; cook the edamame for 3 minutes.
Build bowls with quinoa, kale, edamame, sliced avocado and flaked salmon.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sprinkle sesame.

title: Veggie egg muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line six muffin holes.
Chop the vegetables finely and divide between the holes.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt, pour over and top with cheddar.
Bake for 18–20 minutes until set; two muffins make a serving.

title: Cottage cheese fruit bowl
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with diced pineapple and walnuts.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Buffalo chicken lettuce wraps
steps: Cook the chicken in a pan until done, then shred it.
Toss with melted butter and hot sauce.
Mix the yogurt with garlic powder and salt for a dip.
Spoon into lettuce cups and top with thin celery and carrot sticks; serve the dip on the side.

title: Turkey meatloaf with mash
steps: Mix the turkey with oats, egg, grated onion, half the ketchup, Worcestershire and salt.
Press into a loaf tin, brush with the remaining ketchup and bake at 190°C for 45 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and mash with warm milk and butter.
Steam the green beans.
Slice and serve.

title: Greek yogurt berry parfait
steps: Layer half the yogurt in a glass.
Add half the fruit and granola.
Repeat the layers.
Finish with a drizzle of honey.

title: Tuna melt on rye
steps: Mix the tuna with yogurt, chopped spring onion and a pinch of salt.
Spread on the rye bread and top with sliced tomato and cheddar.
Grill until the cheese melts.

title: Chicken sweet potato hash
steps: Dice the sweet potato and fry in the oil until nearly tender.
Add diced chicken, pepper and onion with paprika and cook until the chicken is done.
Make two wells and crack in the eggs, then cover until set.
Season and serve.

title: Black bean burger
steps: Mash the beans, leaving some texture, and mix with oats, grated onion, spices and salt.
Shape into two patties and chill for 10 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 4–5 minutes each side.
Serve in toasted bagels with tomato, lettuce and ketchup.

title: Steak and rocket salad
steps: Season the steak and sear for 3–4 minutes each side, then rest and slice.
Toss the leaves and tomatoes with oil, vinegar and salt.
Top with the steak, sliced avocado and shaved parmesan.

title: Apple with peanut butter
steps: Slice the apple.
Serve with peanut butter for dipping.
Add a pot of Greek yogurt on the side.

title: Chocolate banana protein shake
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour and drink straight away.

title: Lighter full English
steps: Grill the bacon and halved tomato.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil.
Warm the beans and poach the eggs.
Toast the bread and serve everything together.

title: Oven-baked cod, chips and peas
steps: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss with most of the oil and salt and bake at 220°C for 30 minutes.
Dust the cod with flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and bake for the last 15 minutes of the chips.
Boil the peas and crush them lightly.
Serve with lemon.

title: Shepherd's pie
steps: Brown the lamb, then add the onion, carrot and celery and soften.
Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire and stock and simmer for 20 minutes; add the peas.
Boil the potatoes and mash with milk and butter.
Spoon the filling into a dish, top with mash and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.

title: Roast chicken with roast vegetables
steps: Toss the potatoes, carrot and onion with oil, thyme and salt in a tray.
Add the chicken and garlic and roast at 200°C for 45–50 minutes.
Steam the broccoli.
Make a quick gravy by thickening the hot stock and pan juices with the cornflour.
Serve together.

title: Beans on toast with egg
steps: Warm the beans.
Toast the bread and fry or poach the egg.
Pile the beans on toast and grate over the cheddar.
Top with the egg.

title: Chicken and leek pie with mash topping
steps: Soften the sliced leek and mushrooms in a pan with a splash of stock.
Add the diced chicken, the rest of the stock and the milk, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Thicken with cornflour mixed with a little cold milk and stir in the mustard.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter.
Spread the chicken mix in a dish, top with mash and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

title: Smoked salmon and cream cheese bagel
steps: Toast the bagel.
Spread with cream cheese.
Add the smoked salmon and thin cucumber slices.
Squeeze over a little lemon.

title: Porridge with berries and seeds
steps: Cook the oats with the milk, stirring, for 4–5 minutes.
Top with the berries and seeds.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Ploughman's protein plate
steps: Boil the egg for 8 minutes and halve it.
Arrange the ham, cheddar, egg, sliced apple and vegetables on a plate.
Add the bread and a little mustard.

title: Lentil cottage pie
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms in the oil.
Add the lentils, tomato paste, thyme and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Boil the potato and sweet potato and mash them.
Top the lentils with the mash and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

title: Lighter fish pie
steps: Poach the fish in the milk for 5 minutes, then lift out and flake.
Thicken the milk with the cornflour, stir in the softened leek, spinach, parsley and prawns.
Fold the fish through and spoon into a dish.
Top with potato mashed with the butter and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.

title: Jacket potato with tuna and sweetcorn
steps: Bake the potato at 200°C for about an hour until crisp outside.
Mix the tuna with sweetcorn, yogurt, spring onion and salt.
Split the potato and pile the filling in.

title: Chicken and butter bean casserole
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic.
Add the paprika, thyme, tomatoes, stock, beans and chicken and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with wholemeal bread.

title: Kedgeree
steps: Poach the haddock in simmering water for 6 minutes and flake.
Cook the rice; boil the eggs for 8 minutes and quarter them.
Soften the onion in the butter with the curry powder.
Fold in the rice, peas and fish, then top with eggs, parsley and lemon.

title: Chicken and mushroom stroganoff
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the chicken strips in the oil until browned, then add onion and mushrooms.
Add paprika and stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and finish with parsley.

title: Scrambled eggs on an English muffin
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt.
Melt the butter over low heat, add the eggs and stir slowly until softly set.
Toast the muffin halves.
Spoon the eggs on top and scatter with sliced spring onion.

title: Roast beef dinner
steps: Roast the potatoes and carrots in oil at 210°C for 40 minutes.
Whisk the flour, egg and milk and bake in a hot oiled tin for 20 minutes to make small puddings.
Sear the beef and roast it for 15–20 minutes, then rest and slice.
Steam the broccoli and thicken the stock with cornflour for gravy.

title: Tomato soup with cheese toastie
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes, then blend.
Make two sandwiches with the cheddar and toast them in a dry pan until golden.
Serve with the soup.

title: Chicken burrito bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Season the chicken with the spices and salt and cook in the oil until done, then slice.
Warm the beans and corn.
Make a salsa with chopped tomato, onion, coriander and lime.
Build bowls with rice, beans, corn, chicken, salsa and a spoon of yogurt.

title: Beef tacos with pico de gallo
steps: Brown the beef with the spices and salt.
Make pico de gallo from chopped tomato, onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with beef, lettuce, pico and cheese.

title: Huevos rancheros
steps: Warm the beans with the onion in half the oil and mash lightly.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil.
Warm the tortillas.
Top the tortillas with beans, eggs, salsa, avocado and coriander.

title: Chicken fajitas
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
Toss with the spices, lime and salt.
Stir-fry in a very hot pan with the oil until charred and cooked.
Serve in warm tortillas with yogurt and salsa.

title: Prawn tacos with lime slaw
steps: Toss the prawns with chilli, garlic, oil and salt and cook for 2–3 minutes until pink.
Shred the cabbage and mix with lime, yogurt and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with slaw, prawns, avocado and coriander.

title: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
steps: Roast the diced sweet potato with the oil at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Mix with the beans, softened onion and half the spices.
Simmer the passata with garlic and the rest of the spices to make the sauce.
Fill and roll the tortillas, lay them in a dish, cover with sauce and cheese, and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Chicken tortilla soup
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock with onion, garlic and spices for 15 minutes, then shred.
Add the tomatoes, beans and corn and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut the tortillas into strips and bake until crisp.
Serve the soup topped with tortilla strips, avocado and lime.

title: Mexican-style egg scramble
steps: Soften the onion and jalapeño in the oil with cumin.
Add the beans and tomato and warm through.
Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until just set.
Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Carne asada rice bowl
steps: Marinate the steak in lime, garlic, spices, oil and salt for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice and warm the beans.
Sear the steak in a very hot pan for 3–4 minutes each side, rest and slice thinly.
Serve with rice, beans and a quick tomato-onion-coriander salsa.

title: Guacamole with veg sticks and tortilla
steps: Mash the avocado with lime and salt.
Fold in finely chopped tomato, onion and coriander.
Cut the tortillas into wedges and toast them until crisp.
Serve with the cucumber sticks.

title: Fish Veracruz
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, olives, jalapeño and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
Lay the fish in the sauce, cover and cook for 8 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Chicken and pepper quesadilla
steps: Cook and shred the chicken with cumin and salt.
Lay the wraps flat and cover one half with chicken, sliced pepper and mozzarella.
Fold and toast in a dry pan for 3 minutes each side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Green chicken and hominy-style corn stew
steps: Blend the chillies, half the onion, garlic and coriander with a little stock.
Simmer the chicken in the rest of the stock with the green purée and oregano for 25 minutes, then shred.
Add the corn and cook 5 minutes more.
Serve topped with shredded cabbage, radish, the remaining onion and lime.

title: Breakfast burrito
steps: Scramble the eggs and whites in the oil.
Warm the beans.
Fill the tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese and salsa.
Roll and toast seam-side down.

title: Street corn and bean salad
steps: Char the corn in a dry pan.
Mix with beans, diced pepper and onion.
Stir lime, chilli and salt into the yogurt and toss through.
Top with feta and coriander.

title: Turkey taco lettuce cups
steps: Brown the turkey with onion and spices.
Add chopped tomato and cook until dry.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.
Top with avocado, cheese and lime.

title: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki
steps: Marinate the chicken cubes in lemon, oil, oregano, half the garlic and salt.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 12–15 minutes.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry and mix with yogurt, dill and the remaining garlic.
Serve with warm pita, sliced tomato and onion.

title: Greek salad with grilled chicken
steps: Grill the chicken until cooked through and slice.
Cut the tomato, cucumber, pepper and onion into chunks.
Toss with olives, oil, vinegar, oregano and salt.
Top with crumbled feta and the chicken.

title: Chickpeas with spinach (espinacas con garbanzos)
steps: Fry the garlic gently in the oil until golden.
Add the paprika and cumin, then the spinach until wilted.
Stir in the chickpeas and a splash of water and simmer for 8 minutes, crushing a few.
Finish with vinegar and serve with toasted sourdough.

title: Lemon-herb salmon with greens
steps: Arrange the salmon and vegetables on a tray.
Drizzle with oil, lemon, garlic and salt.
Roast at 200°C for 14–15 minutes.
Scatter with dill.

title: Mediterranean quinoa salad
steps: Simmer the quinoa for 15 minutes and cool.
Chop the vegetables and parsley.
Toss everything with lemon, oil and salt.
Keeps well in the fridge for lunches.

title: Prawn saganaki
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the prawns, crumble the feta over and bake at 200°C for 8 minutes.
Scatter parsley and serve with sourdough for dipping.

title: Warm lentil salad with feta
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20–25 minutes until tender but holding shape.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Toss the warm lentils with the dressing, rocket, tomato and pepper.
Crumble the feta on top.

title: Tuna niçoise salad
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Sear the tuna for 1–2 minutes each side and slice.
Toss the leaves, potatoes, beans, tomatoes and olives with a mustard dressing, then top with egg and tuna.

title: Ratatouille with white beans
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the diced aubergine, courgette and pepper and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, thyme and beans and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in basil and serve with sourdough.

title: Lemon chicken with herby rice
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add garlic, rice and stock, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, lemon and parsley and rest for 5 minutes.
Crumble feta over to serve.

title: Sardines on toast with tomato
steps: Toast the bread.
Grate or slice the tomato over the toast.
Top with the sardines, lemon and parsley.

title: Turkey and rice stuffed peppers
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the turkey with onion and garlic, then add tomatoes, oregano, rice and salt.
Halve and seed the peppers and fill them.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes.

title: White bean and tuna salad
steps: Drain and rinse the beans.
Toss with flaked tuna, thinly sliced onion, parsley and rocket.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt.

title: Spanish tortilla with salad
steps: Slice the potatoes and onion thinly and cook slowly in the oil until soft, about 15 minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt and stir in the potatoes.
Cook in a non-stick pan over low heat until mostly set, then flip and cook for 3 more minutes.
Serve in wedges with salad.

title: Mackerel, beetroot and lentil salad
steps: Roast the mackerel at 200°C for 12 minutes; boil the beetroot until tender and wedge it.
Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with lemon and dill.
Toss the lentils, beetroot and rocket with oil and top with flaked mackerel and dressing.

title: Greek yogurt with walnuts and honey
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with walnuts.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Chicken pesto pasta with greens
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Cook the sliced chicken in a hot pan until done.
Toss the drained pasta with pesto, spinach, tomato and chicken.
Finish with parmesan.

title: Turkey bolognese
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil.
Add the turkey and brown it.
Stir in passata, tomato paste and oregano and simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the pasta and serve with the sauce and parmesan.

title: Minestrone with beans
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the courgette, beans and pasta and cook for 10–12 minutes.
Stir in basil and season.

title: Margherita flatbread pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Spread passata over the pitas and add torn mozzarella and oregano.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until bubbling.
Top with basil, rocket and a drizzle of oil.

title: Chicken cacciatore
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add onion, pepper, mushrooms and garlic and soften.
Add tomatoes, olives and rosemary and simmer for 30 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and serve alongside.

title: Garlic prawn linguine
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry the garlic and chilli gently in the oil, then add the prawns and tomato for 3 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta, lemon and parsley.

title: Spinach and ricotta pasta bake
steps: Boil the pasta until just underdone.
Wilt the spinach and mix with ricotta, nutmeg and salt.
Simmer the passata with garlic and basil.
Combine everything in a dish, top with mozzarella and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken and mushroom risotto
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in the butter and set aside.
Soften the onion, garlic and mushrooms, then stir in the rice.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Return the chicken, stir in parmesan and thyme, and rest for 2 minutes.

title: Caprese salad with chickpeas
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.
Arrange with the chickpeas and basil.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic and season.

title: Cod puttanesca
steps: Simmer the tomatoes with garlic, chilli, olives and oil for 10 minutes.
Nestle the cod into the sauce, cover and cook for 8 minutes.
Boil the pasta.
Serve the fish and sauce over the pasta with parsley.

title: Beef meatballs in tomato sauce
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt and roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil.
Add onion, remaining garlic and passata and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve over the pasta with basil.

title: Vegetable frittata
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Pour in the beaten eggs with parmesan and salt.
Cook on low for 5 minutes, then finish under the grill until set.

title: Pasta e fagioli
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil.
Add passata, stock, rosemary and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, adding water if needed.
Season and serve thick.

title: Baked chicken parmesan with salad
steps: Flatten the chicken, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
Bake on an oiled tray at 210°C for 18 minutes.
Spoon passata over, top with mozzarella and bake 7 more minutes.
Serve with rocket and tomato salad.

title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the beef thinly and toss with half the cornflour and a little soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef in very hot oil until browned and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli with garlic and ginger, then add the sauces, remaining cornflour mixed with water, and the beef.
Finish with sesame oil and serve with the rice.

title: Teriyaki salmon rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Brush the salmon with teriyaki and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes, basting once.
Cook the edamame and slice the cucumber.
Serve over rice with spring onion and sesame.

title: Baked chicken katsu curry
steps: Dip the chicken in egg, coat with breadcrumbs, drizzle with oil and bake at 210°C for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Soften the onion and carrot, stir in flour and curry powder, then whisk in stock, soy and honey and simmer until thick.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with the sauce.

title: Tofu and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Soak or boil the noodles as the pack directs.
Cube the tofu, toss with cornflour and fry in the oil until crisp.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Toss with the noodles, tofu and soy sauce and finish with sesame.

title: Korean-style beef bowl
steps: Grate the pear and mix with soy, garlic, ginger, sugar and sesame oil; marinate the thinly sliced beef for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice and wilt the spinach.
Sear the beef in a very hot pan in batches.
Serve over rice with spinach, kimchi and spring onion.

title: Chicken egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice ahead and cool it.
Stir-fry the diced chicken in the oil until done, then add garlic, peas and carrot.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then add the rice and toss on high heat.
Season with soy and sesame oil and finish with spring onion.

title: Miso soba noodle soup with tofu and egg
steps: Cook the soba and rinse it; soft-boil the eggs for 6 minutes and halve them.
Heat the stock with mushrooms and pak choi for 3 minutes.
Take off the heat and whisk in the miso, then add cubed tofu.
Divide the noodles between bowls, pour over the soup and top with the eggs, spring onion, nori and a drizzle of sesame oil.

title: Chicken yakitori skewers with rice
steps: Simmer the soy, honey and grated ginger until syrupy.
Thread the chicken and spring onion onto skewers and grill, brushing with the glaze, for 12 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Slice the cucumber and dress with vinegar.

title: Mapo-style tofu with pork
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the pork in the oil with garlic, ginger and chilli.
Add the stock and soy sauce, then gently add the cubed tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Thicken with cornflour mixed with water and finish with spring onion.

title: Ginger prawn noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the prawns in the oil with garlic and ginger until pink.
Add the pak choi and sauces, then toss through the noodles.
Top with spring onion.

title: Chicken and egg rice bowl (oyakodon)
steps: Cook the rice.
Simmer the sliced onion in stock, soy and sugar for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces and cook for 6 minutes.
Pour over the beaten eggs, cover and cook until just set, then slide onto the rice with spring onion.

title: Kimchi tofu stew
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the kimchi and onion in the sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Add garlic, chilli, soy, mushrooms and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer 5 more minutes; top with spring onion.

title: Salted edamame
steps: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and drain.
Toss with salt and sesame seeds.
Eat warm or cold.

title: Salmon poke-style bowl
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool slightly.
Cube the salmon and toss with soy, sesame oil and lime.
Arrange the rice, salmon, avocado, cucumber and edamame in bowls.
Top with strips of nori and sesame.
Use sushi-grade fish if serving raw, or sear the salmon first.

title: Sesame chicken lettuce cups
steps: Cook the chicken mince in the sesame oil with garlic and ginger, breaking it up.
Add the grated carrot, soy sauce and hoisin and cook until glossy.
Spoon into crisp lettuce leaves.
Top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Hoisin turkey wraps
steps: Slice the turkey thinly and stir-fry in the oil until cooked.
Toss with the hoisin sauce.
Cut the cucumber and spring onion into thin sticks.
Wrap everything in the warm tortillas.

title: Beef noodle soup (pho-style)
steps: Simmer the stock with charred onion, ginger, cinnamon and cloves for 20 minutes, then strain and add the fish sauce.
Soak or cook the noodles.
Slice the beef as thinly as possible.
Put noodles and raw beef in bowls and ladle over the boiling broth to cook it.
Top with sprouts, basil, chilli and lime.

title: Thai green-style chicken curry
steps: Blend the chilli, garlic, ginger, coriander and lime into a paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 2 minutes, add the chicken and seal.
Pour in the coconut milk and fish sauce and simmer with the vegetables for 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Chicken pad thai
steps: Soak the noodles until soft.
Stir-fry the chicken and garlic in the oil, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles with tamarind, fish sauce and sugar and toss until coated.
Add sprouts and spring onion, then top with chopped peanuts and lime.

title: Vietnamese chicken and cabbage salad
steps: Poach the chicken for 12–15 minutes, cool and shred.
Soak the noodles until soft and finely shred the cabbage and carrot.
Mix the lime, fish sauce, sugar and chilli into a dressing.
Toss everything with the herbs and top with peanuts.

title: Nasi goreng with egg
steps: Cook the rice ahead and cool it.
Fry the shallot, garlic and chilli, then add diced chicken and cabbage.
Add the rice, soy and sugar and fry until hot and lightly crisp.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with sliced cucumber.

title: Thai basil pork with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the garlic and chilli in the oil, then add the pork and green beans.
Add the sauces and cook until glossy, then stir through the basil.
Fry the eggs and serve on top of the rice and pork.

title: Hot and sour prawn soup
steps: Simmer the stock with sliced ginger and chilli for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and tomato for 3 minutes, then the prawns until pink.
Season with lime and fish sauce.
Pour over cooked noodles and top with coriander.

title: Chicken satay with cucumber salad
steps: Marinate the chicken strips in soy, curry powder and a little lime.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 10–12 minutes.
Warm the peanut butter, coconut milk, honey and remaining lime into a sauce.
Serve with rice and a cucumber and onion salad.

title: Tofu laksa
steps: Fry the garlic, ginger and curry powder briefly in a dry pan.
Add the stock and coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cubed tofu, pak choi and soy sauce for 4 minutes.
Pour over the cooked noodles and top with sprouts, coriander and lime.

title: Coconut mango oats
steps: Cook the oats with the milk and coconut milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chia.
Top with diced mango.

title: Steamed coconut fish curry
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, egg, curry powder, garlic, ginger, lime and fish sauce.
Line a dish with spinach, add the fish chunks and pour the mixture over.
Cover and steam or bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until set.
Serve with rice.

title: Chicken larb lettuce cups
steps: Toast the raw rice in a dry pan until golden and grind it coarsely.
Cook the chicken in a dry pan, breaking it up, until done.
Toss with shallot, herbs, lime, fish sauce, chilli and the toasted rice powder.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and serve with cucumber.

title: Tofu scramble on toast
steps: Crumble the tofu with your fingers.
Soften the onion in the oil, add turmeric and the tofu and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the tomato and spinach until wilted and season.
Serve on toasted sourdough.

title: Soy milk overnight oats with berries
steps: Stir the oats and soy milk together in a jar.
Swirl in the peanut butter and maple syrup.
Chill overnight.
Top with berries in the morning.

title: Green protein smoothie
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Drink straight away.

title: Chicken, rice and broccoli meal-prep box
steps: Cook the rice.
Season the chicken with paprika, garlic powder and salt and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, then slice.
Steam the broccoli.
Divide everything between four boxes and drizzle with soy and oil.

title: Turkey and sweet potato meal-prep box
steps: Cube the sweet potatoes, toss with half the oil and roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Brown the turkey with onion and spices in the rest of the oil.
Steam the green beans.
Divide between four boxes.

title: Tuna pasta salad
steps: Boil the pasta, then cool under running water.
Mix the yogurt and mayonnaise.
Toss with the pasta, tuna, corn, pepper and spring onion.
Season and chill.

title: Lentil bolognese
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil.
Add the lentils, passata, oregano and 400 ml water and simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Serve the sauce over the pasta.

title: Coconut chickpea curry
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil, then add the curry powder.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

title: Peanut tofu noodles
steps: Soak or cook the rice noodles as the pack directs and rinse.
Fry the cubed tofu in the oil until golden.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, lime, garlic and a little hot water into a sauce.
Toss the noodles, tofu and sliced vegetables with the sauce and top with spring onion.

title: Chia pudding with mango
steps: Stir the chia into the soy milk with the maple syrup.
Leave for 10 minutes, stir again, then chill overnight.
Top with mango and almonds.

title: Hummus and roasted veg wrap
steps: Roast the sliced courgette and pepper with the oil at 210°C for 20 minutes.
Spread the hummus over the wrap.
Add the vegetables, chickpeas and rocket.
Roll tightly and halve.

title: High-protein yogurt bowl
steps: Stir the whey into the yogurt until smooth.
Top with raspberries.
Sprinkle with granola.

title: Egg and avocado toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon and salt and spread it on.
Poach or fry the eggs and place on top.
Finish with a pinch of chilli.

title: Rice cakes with peanut butter and banana
steps: Spread the peanut butter over the rice cakes.
Top with sliced banana.

title: Boiled eggs with cherry tomatoes
steps: Boil the eggs for 8–9 minutes and cool in cold water.
Peel and halve.
Serve with tomatoes and a pinch of salt.

title: Beef jerky and cheese snack box
steps: Slice the cucumber into sticks.
Pack with the jerky and cheese.

title: Fruit and nut trail mix
steps: Chop the chocolate into small pieces.
Mix everything together.
Divide into four small pots.

title: Cottage cheese crispbreads
steps: Spread the cottage cheese over the crispbreads.
Top with thin cucumber slices.
Season with black pepper.

title: Kefir berry smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Drink straight away.

title: Chicken, quinoa and avocado salad
steps: Cook the quinoa and cool.
Grill the chicken and slice.
Toss the quinoa with the vegetables, lemon, oil and salt.
Top with chicken and avocado.

title: Salmon and vegetable traybake
steps: Cut the potatoes small, toss with the oil and roast at 210°C for 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli, pepper and salmon and roast for 12 more minutes.
Finish with lemon and dill.

title: Chicken tikka wrap with mint yogurt
steps: Coat the chicken in half the yogurt, curry powder and salt and grill until cooked.
Mix the rest of the yogurt with chopped mint.
Fill the wraps with lettuce, tomato, onion, chicken and mint yogurt.

title: Smoked mackerel-style pâté on rye
steps: Cook the mackerel (grill for 8 minutes) and cool, or use ready-cooked fillets.
Mash with cream cheese, yogurt, lemon and pepper.
Spread on the rye bread.
Top with cucumber slices.

title: Chilli con carne
steps: Brown the beef in the oil, then add the onion, pepper and garlic.
Stir in the spices, tomatoes and beans.
Simmer gently for 35 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Baked fish tacos
steps: Season the fish with spices, oil and salt and bake at 210°C for 10–12 minutes.
Mix the shredded cabbage with yogurt and lime.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with fish, slaw, avocado and jalapeño.

title: Vegan bean and rice burrito
steps: Cook the rice.
Warm the beans with cumin and salt and mash lightly.
Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, corn, salsa, avocado and lettuce.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down.

title: Grilled lamb with Greek salad
steps: Season the lamb with oregano, lemon and salt and grill for 3–4 minutes each side.
Chop the tomato, cucumber and onion.
Toss with olives, oil and feta.
Serve with the sliced lamb.

title: Chicken gyros rice bowl
steps: Marinate the chicken with paprika, oregano, lemon, oil and salt and roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, then slice.
Cook the rice.
Make tzatziki with grated cucumber, yogurt and garlic.
Serve the chicken on rice with tomato, onion and tzatziki.

title: Baked giant beans in tomato
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and beans and transfer to a baking dish.
Bake at 190°C for 30 minutes, stir in dill and crumble feta over.
Serve with sourdough.

title: Pasta primavera
steps: Boil the pasta, adding the asparagus and peas for the last 3 minutes.
Fry the courgette and garlic in the oil.
Toss everything with lemon, basil and parmesan.

title: Tuscan bean and kale soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, stock, rosemary and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Mash some beans to thicken, add the kale and simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve with sourdough.

title: Chicken with ham and sage-style herbs
steps: Boil the potatoes and green beans.
Flatten the chicken, top with ham and herbs and pan-fry in the oil for 4–5 minutes each side.
Deglaze the pan with stock and lemon.
Serve with the potatoes and beans and the pan sauce.

title: Sesame chicken with greens
steps: Toss the chicken pieces in cornflour and fry in the oil until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, soy and honey and cook until sticky.
Steam the broccoli and cook the rice.
Serve sprinkled with sesame.

title: Sticky pork tenderloin with greens
steps: Coat the pork in hoisin, soy, honey and garlic.
Roast at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, basting halfway, and rest before slicing.
Stir-fry the pak choi in the oil.
Serve with rice.

title: Miso-glazed salmon salad
steps: Mix the miso and honey and brush over the salmon.
Grill for 8–10 minutes until caramelised.
Toss the leaves, cucumber, radish and edamame with vinegar and sesame oil.
Top with flaked salmon.

title: Tomato and egg stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil until just set and remove.
Fry the tomato wedges in the remaining oil with sugar and soy until saucy.
Return the eggs and spring onion and serve over rice.

title: Chicken and egg drop soup
steps: Simmer the stock with ginger and the finely diced chicken for 6 minutes.
Add the corn and thicken with cornflour mixed with water.
Stir the soup in a circle and slowly pour in the beaten eggs.
Season with soy and top with spring onion.

title: Spiced chicken with cauliflower rice
steps: Brown the chicken in the ghee with onion, garlic and spices.
Add the tomato and a splash of water and cook for 15 minutes.
Grate the cauliflower and stir-fry it in the pan juices until tender.
Serve the chicken over the cauliflower rice with almonds and coriander.

title: Shakshuka-style eggs with flatbread
steps: Soften the onion in the oil with the spices.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until saucy.
Crack in the eggs and cook until set.
Serve with warm pita.

title: Tandoori chicken salad
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, spices, lemon and salt.
Roast at 220°C for 18–20 minutes and slice.
Chop the salad vegetables and mint.
Dress the salad with the oil and serve the chicken on top with extra lemon.

title: Spiced chickpea and cucumber salad
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and onion.
Toss with lemon, oil, spices, coriander and salt.

title: Paneer bhurji with paratha
steps: Make a quick dough with the flour and water and cook a thin flatbread on a hot pan.
Fry the onion and chilli in the oil, add the spices and tomato.
Crumble in the paneer and cook for 3 minutes.
Serve with the flatbread and coriander.

title: Steak and eggs with spinach
steps: Season and sear the steak for 3 minutes each side, then rest.
Fry the eggs in the butter.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan.
Slice the steak and serve together.

title: Chicken Cobb salad
steps: Grill the chicken and slice; boil the eggs and chop them; crisp the bacon.
Mix the yogurt, vinegar and mustard into a dressing.
Arrange the lettuce, tomato, avocado, egg, bacon, cheese and chicken in rows.
Drizzle with the dressing.

title: Chilli-tomato prawns with courgetti
steps: Spiralise or julienne the courgettes and chop the tomatoes.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic and chilli for a minute, then add the tomatoes and cook until they start to break down.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Toss in the courgette noodles for 2 minutes, then finish with lemon and torn basil.

title: Egg salad lettuce wraps
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and chop.
Mix with yogurt, mustard, chopped celery and salt.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and dust with paprika.

title: Tofu shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Cut the tofu into thick slices, nestle them into the sauce and cook covered for 5 minutes.
Scatter with coriander and serve from the pan with warm flatbread.

title: Whipped silken tofu and berry bowl
steps: Blend the silken tofu with the soy yoghurt and cinnamon until smooth and thick.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the berries and hemp seeds.

title: Soya mince breakfast hash
steps: Soak the soya mince in the hot stock for 10 minutes.
Dice the potato small and fry in the oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the onion, pepper and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the soaked mince and paprika and fry until the edges crisp.
Finish with parsley and season.

title: Seitan breakfast patties with beans and tomatoes
steps: Mix the gluten, chickpea flour, fennel, thyme and pepper, then add the stock and knead for 2 minutes.
Shape into 6 thin patties and steam or simmer in a covered pan of water for 10 minutes.
Fry the patties in the oil until browned on both sides.
Grill the halved tomatoes and mushrooms and warm the beans.
Serve the patties with the beans, tomatoes and mushrooms.

title: Besan chilla with spiced tofu filling
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, turmeric and salt with about 180 ml water to a pouring batter.
Crumble the tofu and fry with half the onion, the tomato, chilli and cumin for 4 minutes.
Pour a ladle of batter into a hot oiled pan, scatter with the rest of the onion and cook 2 minutes a side.
Fill each chilla with the tofu mix and fold.
Finish with coriander.

title: Soya keema bhurji with roti
steps: Soak the soya granules in boiling water for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, add ginger, garlic, chilli and the spices.
Add the tomato and cook to a thick masala, then stir in the soya and fry for 5 minutes.
Knead the flour with water and a pinch of salt, roll two thin rotis and cook on a dry tawa.
Serve the bhurji with coriander and the rotis.

title: Tempeh breakfast tacos
steps: Crumble the tempeh and fry in the oil with the onion, cumin and paprika for 6 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with the tempeh, salsa and sliced avocado.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.

title: Soy and hemp overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, soy milk, hemp seeds and cinnamon together in a jar.
Chill overnight.
Top with the soy yoghurt and raspberries before eating.

title: Banana, oat and tofu protein smoothie
steps: Blend everything with a few ice cubes until smooth.
Drink straight away.

title: Tofu akuri on wholemeal toast
steps: Fry the onion in the oil until soft, add the chilli, cumin and turmeric.
Crumble in the tofu with the tomato and cook for 4 minutes, keeping it soft.
Stir through the coriander and spoon over the toast.

title: Smoky maple tempeh sandwich
steps: Slice the tempeh thinly and brush with the maple syrup, paprika and a pinch of salt.
Fry in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp at the edges.
Layer on toasted sourdough with the tomato and lettuce.

title: Soya and black bean breakfast burrito
steps: Soak the soya mince in the hot stock for 10 minutes.
Fry the onion and pepper in the oil, then add the mince, beans and cumin for 5 minutes.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the mix and salsa and roll tightly.
Toast seam-side down in a dry pan to seal.

title: Chickpea flour omelette with mushrooms and tofu
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, garlic powder, turmeric and salt with 120 ml water.
Fry the sliced mushrooms and crumbled tofu in the oil, then add the spinach to wilt.
Pour the batter over, cover and cook on low for 4 minutes until set.
Fold and serve.

title: Buckwheat and hemp porridge
steps: Simmer the buckwheat in the soy milk with the cinnamon for 10 minutes until creamy.
Top with the hemp seeds and blueberries.

title: Soya chili sin carne
steps: Soak the soya mince in the hot stock for 10 minutes.
Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the soya with its stock, tomatoes and drained beans and simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve the chili over it.

title: Soya ragù with penne
steps: Soak the soya mince in the hot stock for 10 minutes.
Gently fry the finely chopped onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes, then the garlic.
Add the soya, passata and oregano and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the penne, toss with the sauce and finish with basil.

title: Soya chunk machboos
steps: Soak the soya chunks in half the hot stock for 10 minutes and squeeze dry.
Brown the onion in the oil, then add garlic, the spices and tomato paste.
Add the tomato and soya and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the washed rice and the rest of the stock, cover and cook gently for 20 minutes.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.

title: Seitan shawarma plate
steps: Mix the gluten, chickpea flour and half the spices, add the stock and knead into a dough.
Simmer the dough as a flat log in covered water for 20 minutes, then slice thinly.
Fry the slices in the oil with the remaining spices and the onion until crisp.
Cook the rice and chop the cucumber, tomato and parsley into a salad.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and water and pour over the plate.

title: Soya chunk and pea curry
steps: Boil the soya chunks for 5 minutes, drain and squeeze dry.
Fry the onion until deep golden, then add ginger, garlic, chilli and the ground spices.
Add the tomato and cook to a thick masala.
Add the soya and peas with a cup of water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with boiled rice and coriander.

title: Tofu tikka skewers with mint chutney
steps: Cube the tofu and coat in the soy yoghurt, garlic, ginger, spices, half the lemon and salt.
Thread onto skewers with the pepper and onion.
Grill or roast at 220 °C for 15 minutes, turning once.
Blend the mint with the rest of the lemon and a spoon of water for the chutney, and serve with boiled rice.

title: Red lentil and tofu dal
steps: Simmer the lentils with turmeric in 600 ml water for 20 minutes until soft.
Fry the onion, garlic, ginger and cumin in the oil, add the tomato and cook down.
Stir the masala, cubed tofu and spinach into the lentils and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with brown rice.

title: Lemon-oregano tofu souvlaki with salad
steps: Cube the tofu and toss with the lemon, oregano, garlic, half the oil and salt.
Grill or pan-fry for 12 minutes until golden on all sides.
Chop the cucumber, tomato, onion and lettuce and dress with the remaining oil.
Serve the tofu over the salad with the olives, hummus and boiled rice.

title: Seitan roast with roast potatoes and veg
steps: Mix the gluten, chickpea flour, thyme and garlic powder with 280 ml stock and knead into a loaf.
Wrap tightly in foil and steam or bake in a covered tray of water at 180 °C for 45 minutes.
Roast the potatoes and carrots in the oil at 200 °C for 45 minutes.
Boil the peas and thicken the remaining stock with the cornflour for gravy.
Slice the seitan and serve with the vegetables and gravy.

title: Tempeh, quinoa and edamame bowl
steps: Cook the quinoa.
Slice the tempeh and fry in the oil until golden, then add the kale for the last minute.
Boil the edamame for 3 minutes and grate the carrot.
Whisk the tahini with lemon, water and salt and pour over the bowls.

title: Chipotle-style tofu sofritas bowl
steps: Crumble the tofu and fry in the oil with the onion until it starts to brown.
Add the tomato paste, chilli, cumin and a splash of water and cook for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice and warm the beans.
Build bowls with rice, beans, tofu, lettuce and salsa, then add lime.

title: Seitan karahi
steps: Knead the gluten, chickpea flour and stock into a dough, simmer in covered water for 20 minutes and tear into chunks.
Fry the seitan in the oil until browned, then add the ginger, garlic and spices.
Add the chopped tomato and cook on high heat until it breaks down and coats the seitan.
Finish with green chilli and coriander and serve with rice.

title: Red lentil, spinach and hemp soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, cumin and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach to wilt, blend half and add the lemon.
Serve topped with the hemp seeds.

title: Chilli-lime seitan bites
steps: Mix the gluten, chickpea flour, garlic powder and paprika, add the stock and knead for 2 minutes.
Simmer as a flat log in covered water for 20 minutes, cool and cut into bite-size pieces.
Fry in the oil with the chilli powder until crisp and finish with lime juice.
Keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title: Tofu chana chaat
steps: Cube the tofu and dry-fry until lightly golden.
Toss with the drained chickpeas, chopped onion, tomato, cucumber and chilli.
Season with lemon, cumin, chilli powder and salt, and finish with coriander.

title: Bacon, eggs and avocado
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp and set aside.
Fry the eggs in the butter to your liking.
Serve with the sliced avocado and season.

title: Cheddar and mushroom omelette
steps: Fry the sliced mushrooms in half the butter until golden and set aside.
Beat the eggs with salt, melt the rest of the butter and pour them in.
Stir gently, then let the base set and add the mushrooms and grated cheddar.
Fold and finish with parsley.

title: Smoked salmon and cream cheese scramble
steps: Beat the eggs and cook slowly in the butter, stirring, until just set.
Fold through the cream cheese in small pieces.
Top with the smoked salmon, dill and pepper.

title: Spinach and feta frittata
steps: Wilt the spinach and spring onion in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Pour in the beaten eggs and crumble over the feta and oregano.
Cook on low for 5 minutes, then finish under a hot grill until set and golden.

title: Green shakshuka with feta
steps: Cook the grated courgette, garlic, chilli and cumin in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach until wilted and make two wells.
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.
Crumble over the feta.

title: Desi masala omelette
steps: Beat the eggs and egg whites with the finely chopped onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, turmeric and salt.
Heat the ghee in a frying pan and pour in the mix.
Cook until the base is golden, flip and cook for 1 more minute.

title: Coconut chia pudding with raspberries
steps: Stir the chia seeds and cinnamon into the coconut milk and chill for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with the raspberries and chopped almonds.

title: Greek yoghurt, walnut and hemp bowl
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with the chopped walnuts, hemp seeds and cinnamon.

title: Turkish eggs with garlic yoghurt
steps: Stir the grated garlic and salt into the yoghurt and spread on a plate.
Poach the eggs for 3 minutes and set them on the yoghurt.
Melt the butter with the paprika until it foams and spoon it over.
Finish with dill.

title: Low-carb full English
steps: Grill or fry the bacon until crisp.
Fry the mushrooms and halved tomato in the butter.
Fry the eggs in the same pan and serve everything together.

title: Salmon with asparagus and lemon butter
steps: Season the salmon and roast at 200 °C for 12 minutes with the asparagus alongside.
Melt the butter with the lemon juice and dill.
Pour over the salmon and asparagus to serve.

title: Creamy mushroom chicken thighs
steps: Brown the seasoned chicken thighs in the butter for 6 minutes a side and set aside.
Fry the mushrooms and garlic in the same pan until golden.
Add the cream and thyme, return the chicken and simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the spinach to wilt.

title: Lamb kofta with tzatziki
steps: Mince or finely chop the lamb leg and mix with the lamb mince, grated onion, parsley, cumin, cinnamon and salt and shape onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry for 10 to 12 minutes, turning.
Grate the cucumber and stir into the yoghurt with the garlic, mint and oil.
Serve the kofta with the tzatziki.

title: Cheeseburger lettuce wraps
steps: Shape the beef into a patty, season and cook for 4 minutes a side.
Melt the cheddar on top for the last minute.
Wrap in the lettuce leaves with tomato, mayonnaise and mustard.

title: Butter chicken with cauliflower rice
steps: Brown the diced chicken in half the butter and set aside.
Fry the garlic, ginger and spices in the rest of the butter, then add the tomato paste.
Stir in the cream, return the chicken and simmer for 12 minutes.
Grate the cauliflower and steam or microwave for 4 minutes.
Serve the chicken over the cauliflower rice with coriander.

title: Chicken karahi in ghee
steps: Fry the chicken pieces in the ghee on high heat until sealed.
Add the garlic and half the ginger, then the chopped tomato.
Cook uncovered until the tomato melts into a thick, glossy sauce and the chicken is cooked through.
Finish with green chilli, the rest of the ginger in thin strips, black pepper and coriander.

title: Baharat lamb and cauliflower skillet
steps: Brown the lamb mince and diced lamb leg in the ghee, breaking up the mince.
Add the spices and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cauliflower florets with a splash of water, cover and cook for 10 minutes until tender.
Finish with parsley.

title: Mackerel niçoise salad (no potato)
steps: Boil the egg for 8 minutes and the green beans for 3, then cool.
Grill the mackerel for 3 minutes a side.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard.
Arrange the lettuce, beans, olives, halved egg and flaked mackerel and dress.

title: Garlic butter steak with broccoli
steps: Season the steak and sear in the oil for 3 minutes a side, then rest.
