Add the butter, garlic and thyme to the pan and spoon over the steak.
Steam the broccoli and toss it in the pan butter.

title: Garlic butter prawns with courgetti
steps: Spiralise or finely slice the courgette.
Cook the garlic in the butter and oil, add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Toss in the courgette for 1 minute with lemon and parsley.
Serve topped with parmesan.

title: Chicken Caesar salad, no croutons
steps: Season and grill the chicken for 5 minutes a side, then slice.
Mix the mayonnaise, oil, lemon, garlic and half the parmesan into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with the chicken and remaining parmesan.

title: Anda masala (egg curry)
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and score them.
Fry the onion in the ghee, add the ginger, garlic and spices, then the tomato.
Cook to a thick masala, stir in the cream and add the eggs for 3 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

title: Cauliflower cheese
steps: Boil the cauliflower florets for 5 minutes and drain well.
Melt most of the cheddar into the cream and butter with the mustard and nutmeg.
Pour over the cauliflower, top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

title: Tuna mayo avocado boats
steps: Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise, spring onion, lemon and pepper.
Halve and stone the avocado and pile the tuna into the halves.

title: Devilled eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and halve.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt.
Pipe or spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika.

title: Macadamias with cheddar and cucumber
steps: Slice the cheddar and cucumber.
Serve with the macadamias.

title: Smoked salmon cucumber bites
steps: Cut the cucumber into thick rounds.
Top each with cream cheese, a fold of smoked salmon, dill and pepper.

title: Egg white and cheddar omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter, pour in the eggs and stir gently until the base sets.
Add the spinach and grated cheddar, fold and cook for 1 more minute.

title: Pan-seared salmon with garlic spinach
steps: Season the salmon and cook skin-side down in half the oil for 5 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the rest of the oil.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Gulf-spiced grilled mackerel with salad
steps: Rub the mackerel with the garlic, turmeric, cumin, pepper, salt and half the lemon.
Grill for 4 minutes a side until cooked through.
Chop the cucumber, tomato and parsley and dress with the oil and remaining lemon.

title: Sardines with rocket and olive oil
steps: Pile the rocket on a plate and lay the sardines on top.
Dress with the oil, lemon and pepper.

title: Chicken thighs with avocado salsa
steps: Rub the chicken with the cumin, chilli, salt and half the oil.
Pan-fry for 6 minutes a side until cooked through.
Dice the avocado, tomato and onion and mix with the lime, coriander and remaining oil.
Spoon the salsa over the chicken.

title: Tandoori chicken wings
steps: Mix the yoghurt, spices, garlic, ginger, lemon and salt and coat the wings.
Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Roast at 220 °C for 30 minutes, brushing with the ghee halfway, until charred and cooked through.

title: Beef seekh kebab with raita
steps: Mix both minces with the grated onion, chilli, coriander, spices and salt and squeeze onto skewers.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the ghee.
Stir the grated cucumber and mint into the yoghurt for raita.

title: Turkey and Swiss cheese roll-ups
steps: Lay out the turkey slices and spread thinly with mayonnaise.
Add a strip of cheese and a lettuce leaf and roll up tightly.

title: Celery with almond butter
steps: Cut the celery into sticks.
Spread or dip with the almond butter.

title: Marinated olives and feta
steps: Cube the feta and toss with the olives, oil and oregano.
Leave for 10 minutes for the flavours to mix.

title: Pecan and coconut bites
steps: Chop the pecans finely and mix with the coconut, cinnamon and melted coconut oil.
Press into small mounds on a lined tray and chill for 20 minutes until firm.

title: Parmesan crisps with guacamole
steps: Spoon the grated parmesan into small rounds on a lined tray and bake at 200 °C for 5 to 6 minutes until crisp.
Mash the avocado with the lime, onion, coriander and salt.
Serve the crisps with the guacamole.

title: Keema palak (lamb mince with spinach)
steps: Fry the onion in the ghee until golden, then add the ginger, garlic, chilli and spices.
Add the lamb mince and cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the tomato and cook for 5 minutes, then the chopped spinach.
Simmer uncovered until the spinach melts into the keema.

title: Spiced lamb and aubergine skillet
steps: Cube the aubergine and fry in the ghee until soft and browned, then set aside.
Brown the lamb with the garlic and spices.
Stir in the tomato paste and a splash of water, return the aubergine and cook for 5 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

title: Coconut prawn curry with spinach
steps: Fry the onion, ginger and garlic in the coconut oil, then add the turmeric and chilli.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and spinach and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the prawns turn pink.
Finish with lime and coriander.

title: Beef chili bowl with sour cream and avocado
steps: Brown the beef in the oil with the onion, pepper and garlic.
Add the spices and chopped tomato and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve topped with grated cheddar, sour cream and sliced avocado.

title: Salmon and avocado salad
steps: Roast or pan-fry the salmon for 10 minutes, cool slightly and flake.
Mix the mayonnaise with lemon and dill.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber and avocado and top with the salmon and dressing.

title: Labneh, chickpea and za’atar bowl
steps: Season the yoghurt with salt and spread it thickly in a bowl.
Top with the drained chickpeas, diced cucumber and tomato.
Mix the thyme and sesame for a quick za’atar and scatter over with the mint.
Finish with the oil and lemon.

title: Paneer tikka with kachumber salad
steps: Cube the paneer and coat with half the yoghurt, the garlic, ginger, spices, half the lemon and salt.
Thread onto skewers with the pepper and onion and grill or roast at 220 °C for 12 minutes.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and coriander with the rest of the lemon for the salad.
Serve the tikka with the salad and the remaining yoghurt as a dip.

title: Spinach, ricotta and lentil bake
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the oil and mix with the lentils and half the passata.
Spread in a dish, spoon over the ricotta and remaining passata and scatter with parmesan.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes and finish with basil.

title: Ricotta, yoghurt and berry protein bowl
steps: Beat the ricotta and yoghurt together until smooth.
Top with the berries, hemp seeds and a drizzle of honey.

title: Whey, banana and milk smoothie
steps: Blend everything with a few ice cubes until smooth.
Drink straight away.

title: Labneh pot with cucumber and mint
steps: Season the yoghurt with salt and spoon into a bowl.
Top with diced cucumber, torn mint, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of paprika.

title: Cottage cheese and lentil salad
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender, drain and cool.
Toss with the chopped tomato, cucumber, rocket, oil and vinegar.
Top with the cottage cheese.
